name: Alex Grosvenor
original_name: アレックス・グローベナー
source:
The assassinated Emperor, and [url=/c156156]Prince Gwyn[/url]'s father.
The world called him the "Feeble Emperor" for failing to clean up corruption among the aristocracy and doing little to stop the widening social inequality.
He set up the infrastructure to stream the Prince's engagement across the whole Empire. I wonder why he was killed...

[From Digital Artwork book]
